summary: Deploy policies from templates, see your hybrid workers, and undo any change Entra Policy Suite makes.

new.title: Deploy and upgrade templates
new.text: A SuperAdmin deploys a template as a new policy, off or report-only, and missing groups are created first. A newer template version is tested next to your policy before you promote it.

new.title: New Hybrid worker page
new.text: Administration > Hybrid worker shows each worker's state, version and last report, the AD changes waiting or failed, and the steps to add a worker. Several AD forests are supported.

new.title: Get started creates what is missing
new.text: Get started can create v1's authentication strengths, named locations and missing break-glass accounts, each after you review it and give a reason.
new.action: Run the install once more to grant the permission the authentication strengths need; Get started step 1 shows when it is granted.

new.title: Named locations from Azure service tags
new.text: A daily job keeps your Azure service tag named locations up to date. It is off by default and changes no other location or policy.
new.action: When you switch this job on in Settings, switch off v1's own named-locations job.

new.title: Backups / Undo
new.text: Your policies, named locations, strengths and tagging setup are backed up every night and before every change. You can restore from a backup or undo a change, always after approval.
